avis.titre: I LOVE this cleanser. A new holy grail for me.
avis.texte: For some reason, the last few years, my skin has become incredibly sensitive and reactive. After eliminating pretty much everything but cleanser/moisturizer/spf in the day, I'd been using an oil cleanser at night that I didn't love and I think caused congestion, because the many others marketed as gentle cleansers I tried were irritating my skin visibly way more. I quite literally almost stumbled into this product on the end-cap in an Ulta recently, and to the employee that steered me to decide on this one and not another I was considering, I hope your pillow is always cold and your phone is never low battery and the stoplight always stays green for you. I LOVE this product because it cleans my skin, doesn't strip or feel tight, doesn't irritate my skin, doesn't break me out, and is cruelty-free. I love this enough that I will absolutely repurchase despite it being more money than I would like to be spending on a face wash. That said, I've been using just a pea sized amount at night and it's been plenty so I think a bottle will last me a while.

avis.titre: Super Gentle and Great for Double Cleansing
avis.texte: As seasons have been changing in Boston my skin has felt sensitive and dry. I love that this cleanser is so gentle and hydrating. I love using it after a makeup cleansing balm as my double cleanser. Gifted by Farmacy Beauty.

This is such a creamy refreshing cleanser. Made me feel so squeaky clean and yet hydrated after using. I have very sensitive skin and yet didn't irritate me at all. This product was gifted by farmacy.

I thought this cleanser removes makeup but it's mean to be used after taking your makeup off. So now I use this as a double cleanser. It's a gentle face cleanser that doesn't strip my dry skin. Complimentary from farmacybeauty

Gifted by farmacy, I loved this cleanser. I'm a double cleanser girl and went in with the balm first and followed up with this cleanser. It took away all the makeup that I wore for the day! Would recommend for double cleanser girl folk

It has a rich, creamy texture that feels super soothing on my sensitive skin. Unlike some cleansers that leave my face tight or dry, this one rinses off easily and leaves my skin feeling soft, clean, and hydrated. It removes sunscreen and light makeup effortlessly, and I love that it doesn't have a strong fragrance. Gifted by farmacybeauty

FARMACY, gentle cleanser, is perfect with its no scent and it does what it says it does without completely stripping the oils off of my face. I would recommend and I would employ people to share this amazing product. Complimentary from farmacybeauty

I recently tried the FARMACY Green Clean Gentle Creamy Cleanser, and it's been such a nice surprise. It has this soft, creamy texture that feels really soothing on my skin. It cleans well without making my face feel dry or tight afterward, which I love. My skin feels fresh, calm, and super soft after using it. It's gentle enough for my sensitive skin, and I haven't had any irritation at all. It's just a solid, no-fuss everyday cleanser that does its job really well. Gifted by farmacy beauty.

This cleanser feels really soft and creamy on my skin. It takes off makeup and dirt without making my face feel dry. It smells nice but not too strong. My skin feels clean and smooth after using it. I like how gentle it is especially since my face can be sensitive sometimes. Gifted by the brand.

Farmacy beauty green clean cleanser , I love how balance it leaves my skin . It's amazing for the skin barrier and while it's cleansing your skin , it's also moisturizing it. I love that's it's not too heavy and it's fragrance free. I definitely recommend. Gifted by farmacybeauty

I just love this cleanser from Farmacy! The ingredients are amazing. Now that they make a fragrance free cleanse wow love that , ive always preferred fragrance free skincare products for some reason. I recommend. this lathers as it should and really cleanse.

I have sensitive skin that also breaks out easily . I love that this cleanser cleans my face really well . It doesn't make my skin feel tight or dry . I also like that while it's gentle it doesn't remove my sunscreen well . I was gifted by farmacy beauty

The FARMACY Green Clean Gentle Creamy Cleanser is amazing! The creamy texture feels luxurious, and my skin is soft and hydrated post-wash. It effectively removes makeup and SPF without irritation, leaving my sensitive skin calm and nourished. Perfect for a gentle, refreshing cleanse! Gifted by FARMACY.

Gifted by Farmacy! I actually love this - my skin felt so hydrated right after I washed it. I have sensitive skin & this didn't irritate it at all! The texture is creamy and nice. It even took off my makeup!

This cleanser is a great addition to the cleansing balm from the same line. It helps me to remove sunscreen and dirt from my face without any stripping feeling or dryness. Complimentary from farmacybeauty

If you are looking for a gentle cleanser that doesnt have a smell and clean your face without stripping it- this is the cleanser for you! The texture is great and it makes the skin feel clean and hydrated . the product was gifted by pharmacybeauty but loved using it.

love love love this cleanser! I love how creamy this is and how nice it feels on my face! it leaves my skin feeling so clean but not stripped or dry at all! I highly recommend this face wash! gifted by farmacy beauty!

I have been a huge fan of Farmacy products for a while and wanted to try their much hyped Cleansers. This is absolutely amazing! I wear a lot of makeup and have to do double cleansing and this works exceptionally well for that! It took off all my makeup with the second pass and didnt make my skin feel dry at all. complimentary from farmacybeauty

I received Green Clean Gentle Creamy Cleanser complimentary from Farmacy. The cleanser is creamy and gentle, and lathers easily. It does not dry out my skin and my skin felt hydrated and comfortable after wash.
